title: Jerky Italian Pasta
description: A sour, flaky, and savory polish-inspired dish featuring penne pasta.
instructions: Cook the penne pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk until a smooth paste forms.
Slowly pour in the white vinegar, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the feta cheese until melted.
Add the cooked penne pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill and lemon juice.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg and parmesan cheese.
Add the egg mixture to the pasta and toss to combine.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with the smoked salmon.
